candidateObjectiveEnglish: Ask a supplier for arrival information and practice future-call and stock questions without choosing a delivery date.
grammarExplanationEnglish: When will + subject + base verb asks a future-time question. Be going to + base verb states an intention. Is + noun phrase + in stock asks about availability. Could you + base verb adds a polite request.
grammarExplanationFrench: When will + sujet + base verbale pose une question sur une échéance future. Be going to + base verbale exprime une intention. Is + groupe nominal + in stock interroge sur la disponibilité. Could you + base verbale ajoute une demande polie.
